requirements.request: Optional webpage background extension above Avoid Overlap
details: The setting is above Avoid Overlap in Browsing Display, participates in settings backup/iCloud keys and defaults off.
When on, sample the rendered top/bottom page strips, reject foreground-text outliers and retain three horizontal color stops at each edge.
Extend those colors smoothly behind the status/platform bars and bottom chrome. Native rendering includes CSS gradients, images and embedded content.
Throttle captures, wait for scrolling to settle, bound snapshot completion and reject old-navigation results. Disabling stops sampling/observation and ignores the palette.
Browser chrome contrast is independent of the requested webpage appearance. No wallpaper source, image, preset or overlay setting is written by webpage sampling.
